{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm there are no missing or sentinel values in biomarker_final
assert trial_df['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum() == 0, "There are missing values in biomarker_final"
assert (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum() == 0, "There are sentinel values (-999.0) in biomarker_final"

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = trial_df['biomarker_final'].mean()

mean_biomarker_final"}
